(1) PRIOR (val=ALL 214 L277, 321px FOV): iter-1 ep8/train_n200 -> SSIM 0.4413 / hr 0.000; iter-2 ep48 -> 0.5927 / hr 0.000; iter-3 ep160 -> 0.6430 / hr 0.000; iter-4 ep220 -> 0.7022 / hr 0.000, elapsed 1156.9s, params_M 0.2329, train_n=200. HEADROOM (metric of record) PINNED at 0.000 across ALL 4 iters; the pretrain_epochs lever moves SSIM (0.44->0.70, diminishing +0.151->+0.050->+0.059) but never clears the ~0.81 LD-FBP floor. ALL 4 iters held train_n=200 -> train_n is the ONLY untried axis. (2) LIMITER = pretrain-then-FIXED-DC ceiling (structural, CONFIRMED from solver_itnet.py): main() lines 207-216 run itnet.eval()+torch.no_grad() = pure INFERENCE; finetune_itnet() (line 114) is DEFINED but NEVER called; the k=3 DC unroll (forward, lines 76-90) has ZERO trainable params (self.alpha is a plain float line 73, self.projector is fixed analytic PYRO-NN line 74). The ONLY trainable component is the standalone SmallUNet denoiser (params_M 0.2329) pretrained FBP->truth (lines 197-200) that NEVER sees the DC steps. v1 is the STRUCTURAL TWIN of itnet_v2 (same pretrain-then-fixed-DC); the doc records v2 just tested train_n 200->400 and its denoiser SSIM climbed (0.7039->0.7294) but the untrained-DC capped hr at 0. (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 200 -> 300 (+50% data coverage; the FIXED-stratified subset via load_val_split n=train_n + randperm only ever sees 35% of the 579-slice pool at n=200). pretrain_epochs 220 -> 140 is NOT a second hypothesis-knob, it is the budget backstop to hold the HARD 20-min wall at near GRAD-STEP PARITY (200x220=44000 vs 300x140=42000, only -4.5% optimization) so the change isolates DATA COVERAGE, per the campaign train_n-lever protocol. All else identical to iter-4 (itnet_k=3, itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, pretrain_lr=1e-4, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: more data coverage lifts SSIM modestly (~0.70->~0.72) but hr STAYS 0.000 because the fixed untrained DC operator caps the recon below the LD-FBP floor regardless of denoiser quality (exact itnet_v2 train_n 200->400 signature). FALSIFIER (operative): if hr > 0 at train_n=300 (v1 clears the ~0.81 FBP floor), v1 is DATA-LIMITED not structurally capped, and train_n is the live lever toward 20; implausible given v2 twin but the clean discriminator. PREDICTED iter-5 hr = 0.000 (SSIM ~0.71-0.72). (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score): per-epoch cost scales with train_n; from the conservative iter2->4 fit per_epoch(200)=4.474 s, fixed=172.7 s, so at train_n=300 per_epoch=6.71 s -> pred = 172.7 + 140*6.71 = 1112 s = 18.5 min, inside 1200s with ~88s margin (sized DELIBERATELY conservative: the doc warns itnet_v2 iter-4 OVERRAN at 1237s; the 30-min sbatch wall is the only hard fence and 18.5 min leaves ample headroom; ep150 would predict 1179s, too tight, so 140 is the safe decisive probe). grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory: the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint inside the DC step overflows otherwise). v1 has NO max_train_s backstop. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned.
